name: Channel Acid
body:
Minimum Spell Level: 6th.

Your energy blast deals acid damage. When it hits, you can spend a swift action to deal 2d6 acid damage at the start of the target’s turn for a number of rounds equal to your caster level (Fortitude negates). This damage doesn’t stack.
